paper_metadata.title: Balanced mechanical properties of Al0.3CoCrFeNiTix high-entropy alloys by tailoring Ti content and heat treatment

evidence.quote: Al0.3CoCrFeNiTix (x = 0.025, 0.075, 0.15) high-entropy alloys (HEAs) were designed to investigate the impacts of Ti addition and the aging temperature (700 – 900 ◦C) on the mechanical properties of the alloys.
